user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Used across ChatGPT search features to surface content in search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads to verify policy compliance.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawl content used to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits pages when users ask questions or interact via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for generative AI model training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites in response to questions asked by Claude users.
user_agents.scope: Web content retrieved at users' direction during Claude queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build Google's search indexes and perform analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google's search features and products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and features presenting images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related search features and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content specifically affecting the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, such as the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for product teams fetching publicly accessible content and internal R&D.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible site content used for internal research and development across various products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler optimized for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs across various products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler optimized for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs across various products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents; has no effect on Google Search or other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled site content for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules under User-agent: Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple's ecosystem including Spotlight, Siri, and Safari.
user_agents.scope: General web search crawling and rendering to index website content for Apple users.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags/headers.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled data to train generative foundation models powering Apple products.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; determines usage of data crawled by Applebot for AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in the robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content of apps or websites shared across Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Meta platforms like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online web content to enhance Meta AI search relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for improving advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models or improve products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models and improving products through direct indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch links at user request and support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to help AI navigate websites and complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules as it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for Bing search indexing and Microsoft Copilot features.
user_agents.scope: Public web pages and documents across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt targeting bingbot.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Captures snapshots and previews of web pages for search results.
user_agents.scope: Web pages requested for preview generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt targeting BingPreview.

user_agents.name: AdIdxBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls advertiser websites to verify Bing Ads quality and compliance.
user_agents.scope: Advertiser landing pages and ads-related web content.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt targeting AdIdxBot.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawl to improve products and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Content for search experiences such as Alexa; excludes generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions such as responding to Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web fetch on behalf of users; excludes generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler providing a copy of the Internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web stored for open research and analysis.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow: / in robots.txt under User-agent: CCBot or use the opt-out registry.
